text_block_list.text:
I go up to the roof during lunch, where I
find
Мэйсё Дото.

Guh... Th-this drink should help get rid
of my
fatigue...
text_block_list.name: Мэйсё Дото

text_block_list.text:
Yes! T-Тренер?! I'm just drinking a
wellness shot.
text_block_list.name: Мэйсё Дото
choice_data_list: That's a sports drink you're holding.

text_block_list.text:
Oh... R-reeeaaally?! I couldn't tell at all,
and I've
already had so much of it!
text_block_list.name: Мэйсё Дото

text_block_list.text:
The fatigue must have dulled her senses.
The
rooftop is littered with her empty
plastic bottles. I
probably should rework
our future race schedule.
